LightningComponentBundle.description: Home page greeting banner with Astro mascot, a voice-dictation field and a send button. {name} is replaced with the running user's first name. Bilingual FR / EN.

property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'fr' (default) or 'en'. Controls the default greeting, placeholders and speech locale.

property.name: greetingTemplate
property.label: Greeting text (override)
property.description: Use {name} to inject the running user's first name. Wrap any word with double asterisks for the highlighted colour, e.g. 'Bonjour **{name}**, comment puis-je vous aider ?'. Leave empty to use the language default.

property.name: highlightColor
property.label: Highlight color (hex)
property.description: Applied to the **bold** segment of the greeting. Defaults to the CCO FR brand blue.

property.name: idlePlaceholder
property.label: Input placeholder - idle (override)
property.description: Leave empty to use the language default ('Posez-moi une question…' / 'Ask me a question…').

property.name: speechLocale
property.label: Speech recognition locale (override)
property.description: BCP 47 tag (e.g. fr-FR, en-US). Leave empty to use the language default.
